questions.question:
A metallic sphere of radius R carrying a charge q is kept at certain distance from another metallic sphere of radius R/4 carrying a charge Q. What is the electric flux at any point inside the metallic sphere of radius R due to the sphere of radius R/4?

a)$\frac{Q}{ε_{0}} $- $\frac{q}{ε_{0}}$			b)Zero
c) $\frac{q}{ε_{0}} $- $\frac{Q}{ε_{0}}$		d)$\frac{Q}{ε_{0}}$
